notes.title: New HUD
notes.content:
[b]New game HUD[/b]



[b]Game description:[/b]

In the game on Mars, Dom wakes up in a ship without knowing very well where he is, nor why he is there, much less where his body ended up. Help Dom find answers and have fun in this mind-blowing adventure.


Explore:
Explore the scenario looking for answers and interact with different objects.

Enemy:
Destroy the enemies that will appear in the course of the adventure.

Upgrade:
Collect experiences throughout the journey and increase the character's level.

Puzzle:
Go through the various puzzles that Dom will find on your way and explore the scenery a lot to find the hidden objects.

NPc'S:
Help the characters in the story and gain much more experience
